boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Maine Maritime Academy
boards.description: Late-evening study and food destinations with published current hours; several are in Ellsworth, so plan transportation and confirm the day’s schedule before leaving Castine.

cards.title: Nutting Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Maine Maritime Academy, Castine
cards.notes: Set up a focused evening work session, then check the library’s semester schedule before heading over for its 10 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus study stop with documented evening semester hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Nutting Memorial Library lists semester hours until 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: About the Library — Nutting Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Semester hours: Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sunday noon–10 p.m. Verify academic-calendar exceptions.

cards.title: China Hill Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 301 High St, Ellsworth
cards.notes: For an evening takeout or sit-down meal, use the restaurant’s posted closing time and call ahead if your timing is close to close.
cards.short_summary: Ellsworth restaurant with service listed into the evening every day.
cards.evidence_claim: China Hill lists hours to 9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and to 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 11 a.m.–9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Friday–Saturday; confirm before the drive.

cards.title: Crazy Sumo
cards.subtitle: 75 High St, Ellsworth
cards.notes: Use the posted evening window for dinner or pickup in Ellsworth, and check the day because the Sunday closing time is earlier.
cards.short_summary: Japanese restaurant whose published schedule reaches 9 or 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Crazy Sumo lists hours until 9 p.m. Monday–Thursday, 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday, and 8 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Mon–Thu to 9 p.m., Fri–Sat to 10 p.m., Sun to 8 p.m.; confirm holiday or service changes.

cards.title: Shinbashi, Maine
cards.subtitle: 139 High St, Ellsworth
cards.notes: Place an online pickup order or reserve before the evening drive; Friday and Saturday carry the latest posted 9:30 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A Japanese-food pickup or dining option with late-week evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Shinbashi lists hours until 9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 9:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 11:30 a.m.–9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 9:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Thai Sana
cards.subtitle: 321 High St, Ellsworth
cards.notes: Use direct online ordering for an evening pickup, and allow time for the trip back to Castine rather than arriving near close.
cards.short_summary: Everyday takeout hours listed through 9:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Thai Sana lists takeout and delivery hours of 11 a.m.–9:30 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: The business publishes 11 a.m.–9:30 p.m. daily for takeout and delivery; verify availability before traveling.

cards.title: DQ Grill & Chill
cards.subtitle: 265 High St, Ellsworth
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check food, treat, or drive-thru availability, then order before the posted 10 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A chain restaurant with all-week 10 p.m. store and drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ellsworth DQ lists store, delivery, and drive-thru hours until 10 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Published store, delivery, and drive-thru hours are 10 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 245 High St, Ellsworth
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, drive-thru, or an online order for an evening food stop; confirm the location page before starting the trip.
cards.short_summary: A published open-late restaurant option in Ellsworth.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Ellsworth location lists daily dine-in and drive-thru hours until 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published dine-in and drive-thru hours are 10:30 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Pizza Hut
cards.subtitle: 211 High St, Ellsworth
cards.notes: Use the official locator to select carryout, delivery, or dine-in, and note that Friday and Saturday have the latest listed close.
cards.short_summary: Pizza pickup or delivery with a documented 10–11 p.m. restaurant schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s Ellsworth location lists restaurant hours until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published restaurant hours: to 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and to 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday; service modes have separate schedules.

cards.title: Ellsworth Candlepin Alley
cards.subtitle: 25 Eastward Ln, Suite 8, Ellsworth
cards.notes: Check lane availability and the ordering page before going; the venue’s posted schedule supports an evening activity and food stop.
cards.short_summary: A named Ellsworth activity venue whose online ordering page lists 10 p.m. closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Ellsworth Candlepin Alley’s ordering page lists hours until 10 p.m. Sunday, Monday, and Wednesday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sunday noon–10 p.m.; Monday and Wednesday–Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; Tuesday closed. Confirm lane access directly.

cards.title: Acadia 876 Bar and Grill
cards.subtitle: 191 Main St, Ellsworth
cards.notes: Use the food menu and published daily schedule to plan an evening meal; the restaurant lists a kids menu alongside dinner options.
cards.short_summary: Ellsworth restaurant with a documented daily 10 p.m. close and food menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Acadia 876 lists daily hours of 7 a.m.–10 p.m. and publishes a kids menu.
cards.source_title: Acadia 876 Bar and Grill — Food Menu
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 7 a.m.–10 p.m. every day. This card concerns the restaurant’s food service; confirm seating and kitchen availability.
